name: ruvnet-brain-mcp
description: RuvNet Brain thin MCP wrapper for agentbox. search_ruvnet is a namespace-scoped semantic search over the ruvnet-kb corpus in ruvector-postgres (the shared sidecar), embedded client-side via Xinference bge-small-en-v1.5 (ADR-015). No local vector store, no local embedder — one embedding space, one database.
